intersection.headline: Germany play their last match in Adidas kit after 72 years, with Nike taking over from 2027
intersection.summary: Germany's men wore Adidas for the final time in their 16 November game against the Netherlands, ending a partnership of more than 70 years. Nike takes over from 1 January 2027 on a reportedly far bigger deal. The farewell World Cup shirt reportedly sold about four times as many units as the previous tournament's, a commercial high for Adidas.

intersection.headline: WTA moves to build its own merchandise business after Hello Kitty tie-up
intersection.summary: At the WTA Finals in Indian Wells the tour unveiled its first-ever official merchandise collaboration, with Sanrio's Hello Kitty, producing co-branded t-shirts, sweatshirts and a plush toy. WTA chief brand officer Sarah Swanson says merchandise is part of the plan, and the pop-up drew long queues. The tour is also working with Togethxr and Monarch Commerce.

sports.headline: Zverev reaches ATP Finals semi-finals with win over Shelton
sports.summary: World No. 1 Alexander Zverev beat Ben Shelton 6-2, 7-6(4) in Turin to book the first semi-final place. It was his first top-five win of the season and extended his unbeaten run against Shelton to 7-0, which includes the 2026 US Open final. Arthur Fils also won in the same group.

sports.headline: Melbourne FC signs the biggest sponsorship deal in its 168-year history with Penrite Oil
sports.summary: Penrite Oil is upgraded to Principal Partner across both the AFL and AFLW programmes on a two-year expansion. It follows the end of Melbourne's nine-year Zurich partnership and is described as the club's largest commercial agreement.

fashion.headline: Gucci to stage its Cruise show in Shanghai on 17 May
fashion.summary: Kering's flagship brand will hold its next Cruise show in Shanghai as it works to re-ignite sales. The destination show is aimed at the key China market.

marketing.headline: Aperol (Campari Group) becomes a sponsor of UEFA Euro 2028
marketing.summary: Campari Group has agreed a deal for its Aperol brand to sponsor Euro 2028. The deal marks the group's return to top-level football sponsorship.

marketing.headline: Jaeger-LeCoultre launches a free video game to mark nearly 200 years of watchmaking
marketing.summary: WWD exclusive: with Indian game designer Zain Memon, the watchmaker has created 'The Valley of Inventions', an escape-room style game set in 1881. It is the latest chapter of its Made of Makers programme and a creative way to draw new audiences to watchmaking. It is available as an app and on the brand's website, with an in-boutique version too.

marketing.headline: LEON appoints Knoops CMO Romy Miller as chief marketing officer
marketing.summary: Miller joins from hot chocolate brand Knoops, where she was CMO for two years. She previously helped grow GAIL's bakeries. She will lead customer loyalty and like-for-like sales across LEON's restaurants, grocery and D2C as the brand's transformation continues under CEO John Vincent.
